# Jira Cloud REST API (external)

> Jira Cloud's REST API (version 3) on a company's own site, as far as the Jira connector reads a project's issues through it and changes an issue's assignee, due date and status, always with the source's own credential at the site.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `EXT-JIRA-API` |
| Kind | external |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Status | planned |

## Purpose

### Not responsible for

- Holding a credential; each call carries the source's credential from the site's environment.
- Deciding what may be written; the Brain's permits and Knovas Link do (connector protocol 2.0).

### Terms

- change log (an issue's list of change entries; each change to a tracked field adds one with a new id)
- edit metadata (the fields of an issue the calling account may set, and how)
- transition (a workflow step that moves an issue to another status)
- entity property (a JSON value an app stores on an issue under a key; not part of the change log)

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search-jql` | POST /rest/api/3/search/jql - the enhanced JQL search, paged with nextPageToken and isLast, with the change log and the edit metadata expanded | http | `/rest/api/3/search/jql` |
| `issue-read` | GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey} with fields, expand=changelog,editmeta and properties - one issue, its newest change-log entries, its edit metadata and the properties asked for | http | `/rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}` |
| `editmeta` | GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/editmeta - the fields the account may set on the issue | http | `/rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/editmeta` |
| `issue-edit` | PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey} with fields and properties - set fields and issue properties in one request | http | `/rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}` |
| `transitions` | GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions (expand=transitions.fields) and POST with transition and properties - the transitions available from the issue's status, and carrying one out | http | `/rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions` |
| `assignable-users` | GET /rest/api/3/user/assignable/search?issueKey=&accountId= - whether an account may be assigned the issue | http | `/rest/api/3/user/assignable/search` |

## Contract

### `*` (every operation)

#### Always

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/*/A-1` | A call is authenticated by its Authorization header - basic with an account's email and API token, or a bearer token; a wrong or missing credential answers 401. The site is the company's own host. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_client.py`, checks: `test_a_wrong_credential_is_unauthorized_and_the_error_carries_no_secret`; `test_an_email_and_token_is_basic_a_bare_token_is_bearer_and_none_is_refused` |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/*/L-1` | Jira limits the rate of calls and answers 429 with Retry-After when the limit is reached. | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_client.py`, checks: `test_a_rate_limit_waits_as_jira_says_then_answers` |
| `EXT-JIRA-API/*/L-2` | There is no conditional edit (no expected version or ETag on an edit or a transition); a change that lands between a read and a write is not refused by Jira. | critical |  |

### `search-jql`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/search-jql/P-1` | A bounded query (project = KEY) answers the issues the account may browse, page by page; a page names the next one by nextPageToken until the page marked isLast true; expand changelog lists each issue's recent change-log entries newest first, expand editmeta its edit metadata. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_read.py`, checks: `test_a_complete_listing_over_several_pages_reports_a_deleted_issue`; `test_a_cut_listing_reports_no_absence_and_no_state`; `test_the_version_is_the_newest_entry_also_when_jira_returns_only_the_recent_ones` |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/search-jql/L-1` | The search is eventually consistent ("recent updates might not be immediately visible"); a listing may lag a change made a moment before. | standard |

### `issue-read`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/issue-read/P-1` | Every change to a tracked field (assignee, due date, status, resolution, links) adds a change-log entry whose id is an integer larger than every earlier entry's; setting an issue property adds none. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_read.py`, checks: `test_the_version_is_the_newest_change_log_entry_and_moves_with_every_change` |
| `EXT-JIRA-API/issue-read/P-2` | An issue read with properties answers the properties asked for that exist; an issue that does not exist or the account may not see answers 404. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_a_repeat_writes_nothing_and_answers_the_receipt`; `test_a_step_that_cannot_be_carried_out_is_refused` |

### `editmeta`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/editmeta/P-1` | The edit metadata lists the fields visible to and editable by the account on that issue, with the operations each allows (set among them); a field it does not list cannot be set through the edit. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_read.py`, checks: `test_the_edit_metadata_is_read_per_issue_when_the_search_does_not_expand_it`; kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_a_field_missing_from_the_edit_metadata_makes_the_preview_inexact` |

### `issue-edit`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/issue-edit/P-1` | An edit sets the fields of its body and the issue properties of its body in one request and answers 204; a field the account may not set answers 400 and nothing changes. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_a_direct_write_sends_the_change_and_the_permit_marker_in_one_request`; `test_a_write_whose_answer_was_lost_is_found_by_its_marker_and_not_written_again` |

### `transitions`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/transitions/P-1` | The transitions listed are those available from the issue's current status, each with its target status (to.name) and, with transitions.fields, the fields its screen requires; carrying one out moves the status, may set other fields by the workflow's post functions (the resolution), and sets the issue properties of its body in the same request. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_a_transition_to_done_names_what_jira_set_besides_as_side_effects`; `test_a_step_that_cannot_be_carried_out_is_refused` |

### `assignable-users`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-JIRA-API/assignable-users/P-1` | Asked with an issue key and an account id, it answers that account when the account may be assigned the issue, else an empty list. | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasConnectorJira/tests/test_actions.py`, checks: `test_a_step_that_cannot_be_carried_out_is_refused` |
